race.comment: AT THE DISTANCE (2) found form and finished third two runs ago then came back to earth when he broke and finished a long last over 1690m at this track. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Big chance if he behaves in this similar assignment. BUCKLES FOR BERRY (4) settled handy the worked her way to the lead but didn't find enough in the end and could only manage fifth last start over 1690m at this track, that effort coming on the back of some comparable performances of late. Meets a similar quality field and is good enough to take out a race like this. JESSICAS STORY (3) is in the mix following a fifth at her most recent appearance over 1690m at Kilmore. MINNIE MIA (6) is in the mix following a respectable third at her most recent appearance over 1690m at this track.
